set.body: Active direction: docs/VISION.md and docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md (2026-09-08). Complete the pinned eyesim basic-capability baseline through clear public workflows; develop typed plans/codecs alongside real use; prove an independently developed extension and a headless application consumer; then accept and stabilize the foundation. The separate UI is outside this repository. Existing scientific trust evidence remains valid within its recorded scope and must be rechecked for release. Licensed EDF verification and advanced breadth do not gate pure core work. The four core-foundation items capture baseline definition, workflow completion, downstream proof, and final acceptance; reuse existing implementation tasks.
set.title: Roadmap: coherent analysis core, excellent APIs, and modular development
